name: memory_associate
description: Explicitly create an association between memories or entities in the cognitive graph. Supports three association types: 'hebbian' (associative co-activation edge between two memories, default), 'temporal' (predecessor -> successor sequential/causal link), and 'hyperedge' (n-ary association connecting multiple entities, optionally grounded in a memory).

type.description: Association type: 'hebbian' (bidirectional co-activation edge, default), 'temporal' (predecessor -> successor link), or 'hyperedge' (n-ary multi-entity relation).

source_id.description: Source or predecessor memory ID (required for 'hebbian' and 'temporal').

target_id.description: Target or successor memory ID (required for 'hebbian' and 'temporal').

weight.description: Association weight increment (positive float, defaults to 1.0). Modulates Hebbian edge strength or hyperedge weight.

session_id.description: Session identifier for temporal sequence linking (defaults to 0).

entities.description: List of 2 or more entity names to connect in a hyperedge. Used when type is 'hyperedge'.

memory_id.description: Optional grounding memory ID anchoring a hyperedge association.

namespace.description: Target memory namespace (slug or ID). Omit to use connection or account default.
